findings.description: The range is 0.90–1.00 kg bulk coating/kg total formulation inputs (line321), but basis_kind is process_output (line323) whose authored vocabulary explicitly means normalized to process output. Output/input yield 0.95 is not output/output 1.00; machine consumers receive a contradictory denominator. Provisional/QA wording does not remove this typed mismatch.
findings.minimum_correction: Retain the provisional input-yield diagnostic and its true input denominator outside the typed inventory range, as with other retained local diagnostics. Do not replace its true denominator with process output. Remove misleading process_output labels from input-based prose diagnostics too, without adding shared vocabulary in this scoped PCR repair. Regenerate projection.

findings.title: Wastewater generation stage is asserted without native staging evidence
findings.description: The canonical restriction assigns the selected UUID to generation before secondary/tertiary treatment. The fresh native record is a Waste flow with Mass referenceID1, but its route says Secondary/Tertiary Treatment and the generic comment does not establish which receiver interface or pre/post-treatment stage it represents. Thus the asserted native pre-treatment interpretation is unsupported. This does not prove the flow is already treated effluent.
findings.minimum_correction: Retain the conditional physical wastewater locator only if source-owner/provider evidence confirms the actual untreated receiver interface. Explicitly disclose that the Secondary/Tertiary route label leaves this interface unestablished, with actual composition/treatment acceptance, measured density when converted, and provider scope still required. Add aligned manifest interface-pending note and regenerate projection; do not auto-resolve the stage or assert treated-effluent identity.
